ACTION: Install the Caddyfile and certificate state for symoneural-web
COMMAND: sudo install -m0644 ops/Caddyfile /etc/caddy/Caddyfile && sudo rsync -a .private/host-snapshot/rootfs/var/lib/caddy/ /var/lib/caddy/ && sudo chown -R caddy:caddy /var/lib/caddy
FAILURE_POLICY: STOP. Two traps here. (1) The Caddyfile is CONFIGURATION CONSUMED BY symoneural-web, not a unit -- do NOT enable, start or reload caddy.service. symoneural-web.service declares Conflicts=caddy.service caddy-api.service, so starting the vendor unit makes systemd STOP the production web server, which is the opposite of restoring it. The vendor caddy was superseded at the 2026-08-26 cutover and is measured disabled/inactive. (2) Certificate state is COPIED and chowned into /var/lib/caddy, NEVER moved: it is live Let's Encrypt production material and a move that half-succeeds leaves the site without a certificate.

ACTION: Start the services in dependency order
COMMAND: sudo systemctl start symoneural-api && sudo systemctl start symoneural-web
